instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 华润三九应收账款和存货占总资产的比例
output: SELECT report_period, asset_accounts_receivable, asset_inventory, asset_total_assets, ROUND((asset_accounts_receivable + asset_inventory) / asset_total_assets * 100, 2) as working_capital_ratio FROM balance_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '华润三九' ORDER BY report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 华润三九经营现金流与净利润的关系
output: SELECT i.report_period, i.net_profit, c.operating_cf_net_amount FROM income_sheet i JOIN cash_flow_sheet c ON i.stock_abbr = c.stock_abbr AND i.report_period = c.report_period WHERE i.stock_abbr = '华润三九' ORDER BY i.report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 华润三九利润质量分析
output: SELECT i.report_period, i.net_profit, c.operating_cf_net_amount, ROUND(c.operating_cf_net_amount / i.net_profit, 2) as quality_ratio FROM income_sheet i JOIN cash_flow_sheet c ON i.stock_abbr = c.stock_abbr AND i.report_period = c.report_period WHERE i.stock_abbr = '华润三九' AND i.net_profit > 0 ORDER BY i.report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 华润三九扣非净利润的可持续性分析
output: SELECT report_period, net_profit_excl_non_recurring, net_profit_excl_non_recurring_yoy FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '华润三九' ORDER BY report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 华润三九股东权益与净资产收益率的关系
output: SELECT b.report_period, b.equity_total_equity, c.roe FROM balance_sheet b JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet c ON b.stock_abbr = c.stock_abbr AND b.report_period = c.report_period WHERE b.stock_abbr = '华润三九' ORDER BY b.report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 华润三九研发投入与利润增长的关系
output: SELECT i.report_period, i.operating_expense_rnd_expenses, i.total_profit, c.total_operating_revenue FROM income_sheet i JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet c ON i.stock_abbr = c.stock_abbr AND i.report_period = c.report_period WHERE i.stock_abbr = '华润三九' ORDER BY i.report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 华润三九总资产与总负债的匹配情况
output: SELECT b.report_period, b.asset_total_assets, b.liability_total_liabilities, b.equity_total_equity FROM balance_sheet b WHERE b.stock_abbr = '华润三九' ORDER BY b.report_period;
